2. On 25-2-03 the plaintiff instituted the suit first for several declarations and for mandatory injunction for payment of Taka 22,000,000 within seven days. Subsequently, by an amendment of the plaint on 27-1-04, the suit was transformed into one for a money decree of Taka 47,000,000 for price of the works done. 

 32. Besides, we know no law that empowers a Court to grant a mandatory injunction for payment of any portion of the amount claimed in a suit for a money decree for work done.
